title: References apply to amendments.
bodyText: Whenever reference is made to any portion of the Hawaii Revised Statutes or of any other law of the State, the reference applies to all amendments thereto.
bodyHtml: §1-25  References apply to amendments.  Whenever reference is made to any portion of the Hawaii Revised Statutes or of any other law of the State, the reference applies to all amendments thereto. [L 1955, c 57, §1(f); RL 1955, §1-28; HRS §1-25]
